question: Choose the antonym of 'magnanimous':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Petty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"magnanimous"** means generous or forgiving, especially towards a rival or less powerful person. (महान या उदार)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the competition, she was magnanimous in victory, congratulating her opponent sincerely.
 
 
 
• **"Petty"** refers to being narrow-minded, mean-spirited, or concerned with trivial matters. (छोटा दिल या तुच्छ)
 
 
• **Example:** He was being petty when he refused to forgive his friend over a minor misunderstanding.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **'magnanimous' **is **'petty'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Petty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Noble **(उदार ): Having high moral qualities and principles.

 
 
• **Example:** His noble actions inspired everyone in the community.
 
 
 
• **Forgiving **(क्षमा करने वाला ): Willing to pardon someone for their mistakes or wrongdoings.
 
 
• **Example:** She showed a forgiving nature by letting go of past grievances.
 
 
 
• **Generous **(उदार ): Willing to give more than what is expected or required.
 
 
• **Example:** His generous donation helped build a school for underprivileged children.
